name: io.github.proofable/mcp
title: Proofable MCP
description: Give AI agents real access without giving up control through Proofable MCP.

tools.name: proofable_context
tools.description: Return the signed-in Proofable profile and its current read-only context: proof index, agents, permissions, and verifier summary. Use once after sign-in.

tools.name: proofable_verifiers_catalog
tools.description: List the verification checks Proofable supports, including required inputs and supported networks for each check. Verifier IDs select Proofable checks; they are not separate MCP tools.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_check
tools.description: Does this wallet already have the required proofs? Returns pass or fail, not records. To read proofs, use proofable_proofs_get. Omit the wallet when signed in.

tools.name: proofable_verify
tools.description: Create or refresh portable proofs for the requested Proofable checks. For signed-in ownership checks, omit the wallet; the session supplies it. Share a browser link only when this tool returns one.

tools.name: proofable_verify_or_guide
tools.description: Resolve a verification request for the selected Proofable checks. Returns current qualifying proofs when they exist; otherwise returns the single next step. This tool does not create a proof.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_get
tools.description: Read a proof by qHash or search proofs by scope, tags, verifier, or text. With no filter, returns an index hint; scope=all pages metadata. Use include=content for proof bodies and includeComments with qHash for discussion. Omit identifier when signed in.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_update
tools.description: Update a proof you own: title, tags, and visibility (public|unlisted|private). Setting visibility to private revokes public access, so confirm before making an already-shared proof private. Or leave feedback on an accessible proof. Send one kind of change per call: metadata, vote, or comment. Owners can vote on their own proofs. Delegated agents need manage_proofs.

tools.name: proofable_agent_link
tools.description: Check whether an agent is set up to act for your profile, and what it may currently do. Given agentWallet (plus agentId when one account hosts several), it reports linked:true with the identity proof and active delegation, or link_required with the one next step. It does not create, change, or remove anything; to grant or change authority, use proofable_verify with agent-delegation.

tools.name: proofable_agent_create
tools.description: Create or import an agent on your profile. Default: signed-in account. Optional separate account and controls. Generate and retain any dedicated key outside Proofable, then pass only its public address. Keep the same agentId on retries.

tools.name: proofable_agent_mount
tools.description: Load the agent identity, permissions, skills, and context into this project.

tools.name: proofable_secret_create
tools.description: Encrypt and save one secret in the Vault for the signed-in profile. Returns metadata only; the stored value is never returned.

tools.name: proofable_secret_list
tools.description: List saved secret names, types, and update times without exposing their values.

tools.name: proofable_secret_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a saved secret so it can no longer be used.

examples.title: Check before an agent acts
examples.description: Confirm who controls the agent and what it may do before a sensitive action.
examples.prompt: Before you run tools that change data or spend money, use Proofable to check this agent's permissions. Start with proofable_context.

examples.title: Connect an agent
examples.description: Give an agent an owner and permissions on your Proofable profile.
examples.prompt: Link this agent to my Proofable profile. Use proofable_agent_link first and proofable_agent_create only if setup is missing.

examples.title: Reuse a proof
examples.description: Check for an existing proof before verifying again.
examples.prompt: Check whether I already have the required proof before verifying again.
